description: This file defines a Java interface named InitializationDatabase related to initialization services in the salesmanager project. It declares methods to check if the database is empty and to populate it with a specific name, possibly throwing a ServiceException.

classes.name: InitializationDatabase
classes.description: Java interface for database initialization operations, including checking if the database is empty and populating it.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the database is empty.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the database with the specified name, may throw a ServiceException.
